title: Sea renity Now! Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
h1: Sea renity Now! Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - Beautiful townhome in Gulf Place, minutes to the beach access! - Walking distance to several dining options! - TVs in all bedrooms - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Gulf Place amenities include free tennis, pool and beach access! - 2 Beach Cruiser Bikes - Fully Stocked Kitchen complete with standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) "Sea-renity Now!" is a 3 bedroom/2.5 bath townhome just minute's from the beach in the heart of Gulf Place! Private gated beach access is just footsteps away with the main pool and tennis courts close by. There are a total of three pools, three private beach access points, two tennis courts, great shopping, and amazing restaurants such as Shunk Gulley, Pizza By the Sea, The Perfect Pig, The Vue, Sunrise Coffee and more! This is the perfect place to vacation and enjoy relaxing and connecting with your family and friends! The home includes a large kitchen stocked with everything you need to make a light lunch or a five-course meal! Dining for ten at the table and breakfast bar. The living area has a full-size leather couch, loveseat, and comfy side chairs for lounging along with a 75” Smart TV and Dolby Atmos Soundbar for movie nights or catching the game. The main level boasts an open floor plan, perfect for spending quality time with your family! The half bath is on the main as well as the large screened-in patio which opens to the picnic area with games such as corn hole, shuffleboard, and more! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: All Bedrooms on the 2nd & 3rd floors. - Master Suite with a King Bed and a Full pull-out Murphy Bed for the kids, plus a Jetted Spa bath with a separate shower. There is also a balcony overlooking the recreation area. - Guest Bedroom; King Bed with a 42” Smart TV and Full Bath. - 3rd Floor; Full over Queen Bunkbed making it an ideal room for a family or a great room for the kids! This room features a 50” Smart TV with a video game system. This townhome includes everything you need to make your perfect vacation memories! 12/31/2035 3 $200 $1400 $6000 Reviews We had a wonderful stay at Shore To Please (now called Sea-Renity-Now!) at Gulf Place. We are snow birds and have already booked Shore To Please for next winter. The unit is spacious, clean and well decorated and felt like home. The pool that was close to us heated and in a quiet, less windy area so it was comfortable to swim or sit and read, even on the colder days. We were able to play pickleball on the tennis court and the other tennis court was in the process of being converted to 3 pickleball courts. Gulf Place has several good restaurants in the complex and close by so we walked to most places that we ate. We were connected to Shore To Please through Sandpiper Vacation Rentals who were wonderful from the time of booking through leaving. They responded quickly and we felt well informed and in good hands. We recommend Shore To Please, Gulf Place and Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. Andrew Jun 2025 Second stay! The Gulf Place townhouse is perfect! Inside it is very spacious, comfortable, and extremely clean! It has everything you need during your stay and plenty of room for many people. The beds are very comfortable. And the location is excellent! Super close to several great restaurants & shops, and an easy walk to the beach. One of the community pools is a few steps away too. This was are second time at this property and we will definitely stay here again. Sandpiper Vacations were great to rent from as well, great communication!
